title: Better Buy: PepsiCo or Coca-Cola?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc runs a head-to-head of the two cola giants, with Coca-Cola near its 52-week high and PepsiCo near its low. Both are reiterated BUYs, with PepsiCo his preferred pick if forced to choose. Coca-Cola at $85.80 is essentially at his $86.61 DCF fair value — fairly valued rather than cheap — but earns record operating margins around 32%, more than double PepsiCo's, with ROIC of 17.9% versus 14.5% and strength in away-from-home channels such as restaurants, cinemas and sports venues; its premium 24x forward P/E leaves little margin of safety. PepsiCo at $124 trades at just 13.9x forward earnings against a $178 DCF fair value, a roughly 44% implied upside, despite margins sliding from 17% to 15.5% over a decade, healthier-choice headwinds for at-home snacks and sugary drinks, and very negative sentiment. Calls made: KO BUY at $85.80 (DCF $86.61) and PEP BUY at $124 (DCF $178), both reiterations. Summary is based on the captions analysis recorded in the 19:00 run on 2026-10-12; auto-captions garble some names and figures.
